description.value: A vine bursts from the ground in an unoccupied space you can see. When you cast the power — and again on later turns as a bonus action while it lasts — you can have the vine lash at a creature within 30 feet of it that you can see. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be dragged 20 feet straight toward the vine.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Light Side Powers, Level 4
